rules.label: Product Name

rules.label: Net Quantity
rules.description: Net quantity declaration should be present.

rules.label: MRP
rules.description: Maximum Retail Price declaration should be present.

rules.label: Manufacturer / Packer
rules.description: Manufacturer or packer information should be present.

rules.label: Country of Origin
rules.description: Country of origin information should be available where applicable.
